title: The Disney Event Calendar
titleTail: : Every Seasonal Event at Both Resorts, Year at a Glance
h1: The Disney event calendar: every seasonal event at both resorts, month by month
description: A year-at-a-glance timeline of every recurring seasonal event at Walt Disney World and the Disneyland Resort, with each band labelled by confidence.
summary: Fourteen recurring events run across the two US Disney resorts and between them they cover every month of the year, which means the planning question is never whether something is on but which of the overlapping things is worth building a trip around.
notes: Bands show whole-month spans, not exact schedules. EPCOT Arts and Flower & Garden and Walt Disney World After Hours use Disney’s published 2027 dates; autumn and winter event bands use their published 2026–27 dates. Open each event page for exact days and parks.
The Disneyland Resort holiday band wraps from November into January. For the 2026–27 season, Disney confirms a mid-November start and an early-January finish; the event page has the exact dates.

Confidence is shown per band. Confirmed 2026 events have published operator dates; expected bands are planning windows awaiting current-cycle confirmation. A month-wide band may represent only part of that month.
